en: Colorized vintage view over a calm river with reflections of the bank and buildings. On the right stands a large historic complex with a tall church-like tower and cross-topped roofs on a raised embankment. On the left are townhouses and another prominent tower rising above the old town skyline. Trees line the riverbank and the sky is lightly clouded. Printed titles in German appear at the top.
